note: Findings accepted as pre-existing. This file is a RATCHET, not a target: the sieve's measured precision is ~12%, so most of these are fine and demanding they be cleared would be wrong. It exists so a change cannot ADD a finding unnoticed. Shrink it by fixing real defects and re-running --write-baseline; never by loosening a subcheck — tests/test_completeness.py scores every subcheck against the labelled set for exactly that reason.
